title: Are Social Sentiments Inherent in LLMs? An Empirical Study on Extraction of Inter-demographic Sentiments

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with template-based questions about sentiments from one nationality towards another, applying sentiment analysis (e.g., VADER) to the open-ended responses, and calculating the correlation between the aggregated sentiment scores and actual international polling data.

Prompting LLMs with template-based questions about sentiments from one religious group towards another, scoring the responses using sentiment analysis, and calculating the correlation between the aggregated sentiment scores and social survey data from the Pew Research Center.

Prompting LLMs with template-based questions about sentiments from one racial or ethnic group towards another, analyzing the text responses with a sentiment analyzer, and calculating the correlation between the aggregated sentiment scores and actual demographic polling data.
